graphql.query: mutation OpenDocument { OpenDocument(input: { collectionId: "Tickets", id: "{{ticketId}}" }) { documentId documentName objectId } }

request.description: Open ticket as document to get documentId for Get/Update representation calls.

graphql.query: query GetTicketRepresentation { GetTicketRepresentation(input: { id: "{{documentId}}" }) { id } }

request.description: OpenDocument only registers the document; its data is loaded in a background thread (TCollectionDocumentServiceWrap::DoOpenDocument in ImtCore) and the document reports isLoading until that finishes. Every read/write against a still-loading document fails, so this request polls the representation until it becomes readable.

graphql.query: query GetTicketRepresentation { GetTicketRepresentation(input: { id: "{{documentId}}" }) { id number title description status stateReason priority assigneeIds reporterId conversationId messageId labelIds locked lockReason createdAt updatedAt closedAt resolvedAt accessLevel entityReferences { entityType entityId displayName } comments { id userId content edited deleted attachments { id fileName mimeType preview } } } }
